name: Minigolfanlage Franzlhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Mini-Golf Course Franzlhof in Söll**

Discover a fun-filled day at the **Mini-Golfanlage Franzlhof** in the charming village of **Söll**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. This delightful course offers a playful escape for families and friends, surrounded by the stunning Alpine scenery of the **Zillertal** region.

With its creative obstacles and well-maintained greens, the **Mini-Golfanlage Franzlhof** promises hours of entertainment for all ages. After your game, relax and enjoy a traditional **Tiroler** treat—perhaps a warm **Kaiserschmarrn** or a refreshing **Apfelstrudel**—at the cozy café on-site.

Whether you're visiting in summer or winter, this hidden gem is a must for anyone looking to add a touch of whimsy to their **Tirol** adventure. Don’t forget to capture the picturesque views of the **Karwendel** mountains in the background!
